summary: Eshallgo Inc., a Chinese foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering under an existing F-3 shelf. On June 24, 2026, it entered a securities purchase agreement to sell 183,862 Class A ordinary shares at $3.25/share and pre-funded warrants for 271,106 shares at $3.24/warrant, with a de minimis $0.01 exercise price. The offering closed June 25, raising ~$1.478M gross. Univest Securities acted as placement agent (7% fee). Lock-ups were imposed on insiders for 90 days. Proceeds are for working capital. This is a routine capital raise via a shelf takedown, not a special situation.
